items.title: Add V1 aggregate evaluator and decision metadata stores
items.context: Covers M4 plus the decision-log/non-deducible storage parts of sections 12 and 13. Implement pure aggregation from explicit PlaybookOutcomeEvent rows, pure evaluatePlaybookPromotion thresholds, aggregate digest/reason codes, decision log row validation, non-deducible registry helpers, retention/health diagnostics, and tests that prove neutral/unknown cannot promote and harmful/wrong-claim prevents activation recommendation.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes "recommend_activate", "reject", "hold", "archive", "recommend_demote", and "mark_non_deducible" decision lines.

happy.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 candidate with enough helped decisive samples and context diversity returns recommend_activate with aggregate digest and reason codes.
CHK-001:happy:1 repeated rejected sibling decisions for a source returns mark_non_deducible and can persist registry metadata.

edge.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 neutral and unknown rows keep decisiveSamples at zero and evaluator returns hold, not recommend_activate.
CHK-001:edge:1 learning artifacts under .lattice/learning remain material-hash excluded runtime artifacts.

adversarial.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:0 harmful or causedWrongClaim evidence prevents activation recommendation even when helped samples exist.
CHK-001:adversarial:1 malformed or prototype-polluted decision/outcome rows fail closed through own-property validation.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke covers recommend_activate with helped decisive samples, context diversity, aggregateDigest, and reason codes.
Focused smoke covers rejected sibling decisions producing mark_non_deducible and persisted registry metadata.
Focused smoke covers neutral and unknown rows leaving decisiveSamples at zero and returning hold.
Focused smoke asserts .lattice/learning remains material-hash excluded via runtime artifact registry prefix.
Focused smoke covers harmful and causedWrongClaim evidence preventing activation recommendation.
Focused smoke covers inherited/prototype-polluted decision and outcome rows failing closed.

items.title: Add playbook_promotion_sweep dry-run and apply
items.context: Covers M5 and sections 15.2, 16, 17, and 18. Default dry-run must write nothing; apply is feature-flag gated, idempotent, appends auditable decision rows, preserves unrelated playbooks, can recommend activation/recommend demotion/reject/archive/mark non-deducible, and must never activate candidates or write lifecycle evidence.
items.userSees: CLI output includes "dryRun: true", "applied: false", and repeated apply reports "alreadyApplied" without activating candidates.

happy.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 dry-run evaluates candidate and active playbooks and prints decisions while writing no decision rows or status mutations.
CHK-002:happy:1 apply with PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED=1 writes one applied decision row per idempotency key and preserves unrelated playbooks.

edge.desc: CHK-002:edge:0 repeated apply with the same aggregate digest appends no duplicate applied decision row.
CHK-002:edge:1 apply fails closed when the feature flag is absent/malformed/off while dry-run remains available.

adversarial.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 recommend_activate decision records recommendation only and does not call playbook_activate or set status active.
CHK-002:adversarial:1 sweep cannot create or mutate review, validation, delivery, or DONE evidence artifacts.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke covers dry-run evaluation output while decision row count and story snapshot remain unchanged.
Focused smoke covers apply with PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED=1 writing one decision row per idempotency key.
Focused smoke covers repeated apply reporting alreadyApplied without duplicate rows.
Focused smoke covers apply fail-closed when feature flag is absent while dry-run remains available.
Focused smoke asserts recommend_activate remains a recommendation and candidate status never becomes active.
Focused smoke snapshots story files before/after dry-run/apply to verify no lifecycle evidence mutation.

items.title: Guard playbook_propose with non-deducible source registry
items.context: Covers M5.5 and section 13.4. playbook_propose must consult non-deducible source records before writing proposals; marked sources refuse unless an explicit override flag and reason are supplied; override events must be auditable and unmarked sources keep current behavior.
items.userSees: playbook_propose prints "source is marked non_deducible" unless override output includes "override accepted" with the reason digest.

happy.desc: CHK-003:happy:0 unmarked source signature keeps existing playbook_propose behavior and creates a proposal.
CHK-003:happy:1 marked source with explicit override flag and sufficient reason succeeds and leaves audit-visible override metadata.

edge.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 marked source without override refuses before writing a proposal and points at the non-deducible record.
CHK-003:edge:1 override flag without a useful reason rejects as unauditable.

adversarial.desc: CHK-003:adversarial:0 malformed inherited fields cannot bypass the non-deducible registry lookup.
CHK-003:adversarial:1 source signature includes stable source identifiers so unrelated source material is not blocked by collision.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke covers unmarked source preserving existing playbook_propose proposal creation.
Focused smoke covers explicit override with sufficient reason and audit-visible reason digest/override event.
Focused smoke covers marked source refusing before writing another proposal.
Focused smoke covers override flag with too-short reason rejecting as unauditable.
Focused smoke covers non-deducible registry lookup before proposal write plus own-property fail-closed validation.
Focused smoke asserts source keys derive from stable sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/sourceSignature identifiers.

items.title: Add non-blocking post-DONE learning settlement hook
items.context: Covers M3 and section 8. After DONE proof is durable, run a best-effort, timeout-bounded, idempotent settlement that can append neutral or explicit structured outcomes only where allowed. Settlement failure must be visible through promotion status/health but must not block DONE, mutate story phase, or create gate evidence.
items.userSees: DONE/health output includes "settlementStatus: disabled|recorded|failed" and never changes the DONE result.

happy.desc: CHK-004:happy:0 after the DONE durable proof point, post-DONE settlement records a learning settlement health row after proof, not before.
CHK-004:happy:1 done_recover or repeated DONE effects reuse a stable idempotency key and do not duplicate settlement records.

edge.desc: CHK-004:edge:0 when settlement flag is disabled, DONE still succeeds and promotion status shows disabled/no-op state.
CHK-004:edge:1 malformed learning store data records visible settlement failure health without blocking DONE.

adversarial.desc: CHK-004:adversarial:0 DONE success without explicit playbook exposure cannot create candidate helped outcome.
CHK-004:adversarial:1 settlement uses learning-only write path and cannot mutate story phase, checklist, review, validation, delivery, or DONE evidence.

items.title: Add playbook_promotion_status inspection surface
items.context: Covers M6 and section 15.3. Status should show candidates, active playbooks with negative signals, latest decisions, non-deducible sources, pending settlement/health counts, retention warnings, and feature-flag state. Candidates must be clearly labeled pending learning material and must not appear in active runtime memory guidance.

happy.desc: CHK-005:happy:0 status after candidates, decisions, and non-deducible records exist shows pending-learning candidates, latest decisions, registry, health, and feature flags.
CHK-005:happy:1 active playbook with harmful or dismissed signals is highlighted as negative/demotion posture.

edge.desc: CHK-005:edge:0 status with no candidates or decisions succeeds with zero counts and clear disabled feature flag state.
CHK-005:edge:1 retention warnings or malformed skipped rows are reported as advisory health without failing lifecycle commands.

adversarial.desc: CHK-005:adversarial:0 candidate inspected through status does not appear in active runtime memory pack fields or active guidance section.
CHK-005:adversarial:1 rejected archived and non-deducible records remain visible for audit but never render as active runtime guidance.
